notes.title: Major Update PR-517
notes.content:
Over the past two months, we have redesigned the game's upgrade system to provide clearer tactical choices, allowing players to build their own playstyles and enjoy different strategic approaches.

[hr][/hr]

[h2]Build System Overhaul[/h2]
With this update, the upgrade system is now more structured into three distinct build paths, allowing players to choose a strategy that fits their preferred playstyle:

[list]
[*][b]Soldier Build[/b] - Focuses on strengthening soldiers, ideal for players who enjoy micro-management and high skill expression.
[*][b]Support Unit Build[/b] - Grants and enhances more support units (defense towers), perfect for those who enjoy tower defense mechanics.
[*][b]Support Fire Build[/b] - Uses automated sniper and artillery strikes from headquarters, best suited for players who prefer high damage with minimal controls.
[/list]

Additionally, each build can be combined with elemental status effects, adding even more depth to tactical choices:
[b]Burning:[/b] Stacks up to 15 times to trigger a [b]Flame Explosion[/b], dealing area damage.  
[b]Chill:[/b] Stacks up to 15 times to trigger [b]Frozen[/b], immobilizing the target.

Players can specialize in a single build or mix elemental effects to create unique playstyles.

[hr][/hr]

[h2]Update Details[/h2]
This update introduces major changes to the game's core mechanics. The [b]Support Fire Build[/b] has been fully implemented, while the [b]Soldier and Support Unit Builds are still being refined[/b]. We encourage players to test these changes and provide feedback to help us fine-tune the balance.

[h3]Gameplay Changes[/h3]
[list]
[*][b]New Support Fire System[/b] - Headquarters can now launch sniper and artillery attacks, adding automated firepower. Currently, there are six different types available.
[*][b]New Shield System[/b] - Units can now acquire shields, which absorb damage before affecting health.
[*][b]New Status Effect – Burning[/b] - Deals damage over time and triggers a Flame Explosion at 15 stacks, dealing area damage.
[*][b]New Modules, Relics, and Tactical Modules[/b] - More strategic upgrade choices allow for a wider variety of powerful builds.
[*][b]New Enemy Unit[/b] - Enemy behaviors have been adjusted to enhance combat variety.
[*][b]Event Visual Updates[/b] - All events now feature dedicated pixel-art animations to improve immersion.
[/list]

[h3]UI & Quality of Life Improvements[/h3]
[list]
[*] The soldier upgrade interface now displays acquired Tactical Modules, making it easier to plan builds.
[*] The soldier stats interface now provides more detailed values for better tactical clarity.
[*] The map interface now displays special rewards for each node, allowing players to plan their routes more effectively.
[*] Damage numbers now show status effect icons when an attack applies an effect, providing better visual feedback.
[*] A chapter selection screen has been added. Future updates will expand on this, with each chapter featuring a unique battlefield.
[/list]

[hr][/hr]

[h2]Future Plans[/h2]
We will continue refining the gameplay experience and expanding content. Below is the planned roadmap for upcoming updates.

[h3]Pre-Demo Updates[/h3]
Before the demo release, we plan to introduce additional updates, including:
[list]
[*] The 5th playable soldier
[*] Completion of the Soldier Build
[*] Completion of the Support Unit Build
[*] Chapter 2 stages
[*] Sound implementation
[/list]

[h3]Game Demo[/h3]
[list]
[*] Chapters 1-2
[*] 5 playable soldiers
[*] 3 core builds
[*] 2 elemental status effects
[*] First page of Tactical Modules
[/list]

[h3]Early Access (EA) Release[/h3]
[list]
[*] Chapters 1-6
[*] 7 playable soldiers
[*] Third page of Tactical Modules
[*] A highly replayable endgame mode
[/list]

[h3]Full 1.0 Release[/h3]
[list]
[*] Chapters 1-8
[*] 8 playable soldiers
[*] Fourth page of Tactical Modules
[*] A fully developed final challenge mode
[/list]

[hr][/hr]

[h2]Feedback & Testing[/h2]
This update brings significant changes, and we need your help to further refine the game's balance.

[h3]What We Need You to Test[/h3]
[list]
[*] Does the Support Fire Build provide a distinct and satisfying playstyle?
[*] Does the Shield System function effectively in combat?
[*] Do the new Modules, Relics, and Tactical Modules create meaningful upgrade choices?
[*] Are the Burning and Frozen status effects impactful, and does their visual feedback feel satisfying?
[/list]

We would love to hear your feedback! Join the [b]Steam Discussion Board[/b] or [b]Discord[/b] to share your thoughts. Your feedback will help us ensure that each build offers a unique and enjoyable experience.

[hr][/hr]

[url=https://discord.gg/m3CRZ7J]Join our Discord community here![/url]

We look forward to your feedback. Let's make [b]Iron Vulture[/b] even better together!
